title: Reply to a text message
blurb: Answer a customer's SMS from your Luubu Phone number.

steps.title: Open the conversation
steps.body: Click the conversation in the chat list. Unread chats are shown in bold at the top.

steps.title: Choose SMS
steps.body: In the reply box, use the channel switcher to pick **SMS**. It usually picks the channel they last messaged on for you.

steps.title: Write your reply
steps.body: Type your message. Keep it short: one text is 160 characters and longer messages are split into several.
steps.tip: Add a photo or PDF with the paperclip icon.

steps.title: Send it
steps.body: Click the send icon or press Ctrl + Enter (Cmd + Enter on a Mac). Replying also marks the chat as read.
